verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a public REST API in depth. The docs cover concrete endpoints (e.g. GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls, contractor payment group preview, time-off approve/decline) and auth via system access tokens. They also cover versioning through the X-Gusto-API-Version header, pagination, idempotency keys, optimistic-locking version fields, structured errors, and webhook subscription endpoints. Official client libraries and Postman collections back this up, and the first-party CLI and MCP server drive the same api.gusto.com and sandbox endpoints. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the REST API directly; most API docs target Embedded Payroll partners rather than ordinary account holders.
